mapper.select: SELECT `id`, `inviterUserId`, `inviteeUserId`, `bindAt`, `isQualified`, `qualifiedAt`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt` FROM `UserInvites` WHERE `inviterUserId` = #{inviterUserId} ORDER BY `bindAt` DESC, `id` DESC

SELECT ranked.`inviterUserId` AS `inviterUserId`, ranked.`invitedCount` AS `invitedCount`, ranked.`completedAt` AS `completedAt` FROM ( SELECT ui.`inviterUserId` AS `inviterUserId`, COUNT(1) AS `invitedCount`, ( SELECT ui2.`bindAt` FROM `UserInvites` ui2 WHERE ui2.`inviterUserId` = ui.`inviterUserId` ORDER BY ui2.`bindAt` ASC, ui2.`id` ASC LIMIT #{completeIndex}, 1 ) AS `completedAt` FROM `UserInvites` ui GROUP BY ui.`inviterUserId` HAVING COUNT(1) >= #{targetCount} ) ranked ORDER BY ranked.`completedAt` ASC, ranked.`inviterUserId` ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE `UserInvites` SET `isQualified` = 1, `qualifiedAt` = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updatedAt` = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE `inviteeUserId` = #{inviteeUserId} AND `isQualified` = 0
